input_and_geometry: Current source-bound seven successful methods, strict raw terminal protocol and exported observations; no historical acceptance substitution.
colour_timing_limit: Fixture durations include setup+interaction+teardown, exclude export; original source-enforced 45000ms deadline retained. Do not report invented colour interaction boundaries.

method_review.aboutThirdPartyNoticeRetainsRotationAndN: Viewed all four actual captures: French About title/menu and notice body retain their scroll viewport on rotation, and footer controls remain native. A landscape capture shows the title partly scrolled above the viewport; line-by-line native reachability and the completed current method establish access, not simultaneous whole-document visibility.
method_review.aboutArtworkNoticeCompletesNativeFooterF: Viewed native French artwork/credit notice. Wrapped title and body are readable within the scroll viewport; Copy/Other terms/Done footer captions fit. Initial screenshot is a scroll-state sample, not proof that all long text is visible at once.
method_review.aboutGimpTranslationNoticeCompletesNativ: Viewed native French translation notice. Full title and initial body text fit; three native footer actions are visible. Current method/receipt also verifies the nested terms and single-Back paths.
method_review.retainedCreditDialogKeepsDraftSelectionA: Viewed both Hungarian retained-credit images. Portrait title wraps; landscape and portrait contain the same retained synthetic draft context. Initial viewport does not show every action together and a synthetic saved-credit toast appears in portrait. Native line/scroll/pointer receipts separately prove save/copy/done/discard and retained selection/listeners.
method_review.normalAdvancedColourKeepsFiniteViewportA: Viewed allocation, before and scrolled screenshots. Normal-font 640x320 landscape now has a positive inner viewport, stable fixed palette/add controls and native Cancel/Use Color. Actual inner scroll changes from 0 to 55 pixels using the visible end gutter; no fixed-control movement or clipped fixed captions was observed.
method_review.retainedColourStateSurvivesRotationImeCa: Viewed all eight screenshots, with individual full-resolution confirmation of portrait, actual fullscreen IME and post-IME retained state. Portrait stacks controls and keeps all sixteen slots; landscape compacts the same swatches into the native horizontal route. Honeycomb wraps onto two lines without missing letters. Some early rotation/drag images contain a transient synthetic prior-save toast, so they are not unobstructed-footer screenshots. Later post-IME images show the field and footer clearly. Real colour-surface drag changes value without scrolling the parent. The configured Google Latin IME visibly opens in fullscreen extraction mode with #13579B and selected characters, then one native Back hides it while the original dialog/value/selection and zero callbacks remain. A later single Back closes the reopened picker. Final committed value is #2468AC with one commit and three total close callbacks. No simultaneous IME/field/footer fit claim.
method_review.hungarianColourCaptionsFitPortraitAndLan: Viewed both actual Hungarian images. Normal-font portrait and landscape show complete Paletta/Mehsejt/Specialis/Spektrum/Szinkerek and add-to-palette captions, with expected wrapping where needed, and complete native Cancel/Use colour actions. No letter clipping observed in this finite layout review; no linguistic/fluency certification.

limits: API35 emulator only for installed positive colour/notice/credit methods. API30 colour geometry is JVM/model coverage, not selected installed colour tests.
No physical-device, TalkBack, linguistic/fluency or universal accessibility acceptance.
Native scrolling intentionally clips offscreen body portions; this review accepts tested reachability, not simultaneous whole-form/document fit.
Transient synthetic save toasts are preserved in the evidence; unobstructed-footer claims are limited to later clear captures.
The finite PNG profile is a bounded corruption/producer-profile check, not a general PNG conformance decoder. Pillow decoded actual images and reviewer inspected pixels.
